# go-failedjobs

> Persist permanently failed RabbitMQ jobs in MySQL/Postgres and republish selected rows via HTTP (`POST /retry-task`) or `QueueFailedJobSrv.Retry`. Module: `github.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs`. Package: `gofailedjobs`. Requires Go version from `go.mod` (currently 1.25+).

Designed to pair with [go-amqp-adapter](https://github.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter) as a Laravel-style retry → `failed_jobs` → `queue:retry` replacement: wire `srv.GetFailedJobHandler()` into the adapter’s `WithFailHandler`. A row is deleted only after a successful republish.

Key rules for agents:

- Storage backends: GORM or sqlx (`Config.Driver`; empty = gorm). DBMS: `mysql` or `postgres` (`Config.Dialect`; aliases `mariadb`, `postgresql`, `pg`).
- Create table yourself from `schema.sql` — the package does **not** run migrations.
- Preferred constructors: `NewQueueFailedJobSrvFromConfig` (owns DB; call `Close`) or `NewQueueFailedJobSrv` + existing repo (`NewGormQueueFailedJobRepo` / `NewSqlxQueueFailedJobRepo`).
- HTTP: `Register(e, authMiddleware, srv, queue)` — auth middleware is **required** (`nil` panics). Use `PassThroughMiddleware` only if Echo already enforces ACL globally. Route: `POST /retry-task?task=1,2,3` (≤100 unique positive IDs).
- On `Retry`, correlation id `gofailedjobs:failed-job:<id>` is set via `SetCorrelationID`. Propagate to AMQP with `go-amqp-adapter/otel` using `GetCorrelationID` / `SetCorrelationID`.
- If row `connection` ≠ `SetConnection`, provide `SetPublisherResolver` or get `ErrConnectionMismatch`.
- Logger needs `ErrorContext`; `*slog.Logger` works; `nil` → no-op.

## API source

- [Types & Publisher](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs/main/queue_failed_jobs.go): `QueueFailedJob`, `Publisher`, repo/service interfaces, `RoutePath`
- [Config / Drivers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs/main/db.go): `Config`, `Driver`, `Dialect`, `ConnectGorm`, `ConnectSqlx`
- [Service](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs/main/queue_failed_jobs_srv.go): `NewQueueFailedJobSrv*`, setters, `GetFailedJobHandler`, `Retry`
- [Repository](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs/main/queue_failed_jobs_repo.go): `NewQueueFailedJobRepo`, GORM/sqlx wrappers
- [HTTP handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs/main/httphandler.go): `Register`, `NewHandler`, `PassThroughMiddleware`
- [Correlation ID](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs/main/correlation.go): `SetCorrelationID` / `GetCorrelationID`
- [Errors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs/main/errors.go): Client vs server error types used by the HTTP layer
